verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents filtering scan results by severity or confidence, or configuring which findings fail or block a CI build. Related items such as reachability flagging, prioritizing valid secrets, and AI post-processing that reduces noise are different features, not severity/confidence gating, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can filter and gate on findings by severity or confidence so low-value noise does not block builds
